subject: crtf-d
title: CRTF.D.------MT.INFO.
description: Chart on book p. 292 (WI-8). CRTF-D (cross-transfer definitions) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; MT-INFO (multi-information) is the partner. From the subject: INT (intention), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From INT: ALT-D (alternative definitions) and EXT-DYM (extended dynamics). From EXT-DYM: ALT-C-PG (alternative composite progressionalism) and APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions). From APP-RDEF: AFN (affinity negation) and AFTF (affinity transfer).
